entries.source: AI maps on plain paper keep real roof detail from satellite imagery.

drafts.zu: Amamephu e-AI ephepheni elimhlophe agcina imininingwane yangempela yophahla ezithombeni zesathelayithi.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa AI tse pampiring e tshweu di boloka dintlha tsa nnete tsa marulelo ho tswa ditshwantshong tsa sathelaete.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya AI eka phepha ro basa yi hlayisa vuxokoxoko bya xiviri bya lwangu ku suka eka swifaniso swa sathelayiti.
drafts.ve: Mapa dza AI kha bammbiri ḽitshena dzi vhulunga zwidodombedzwa zwa vhukuma zwa ṱhanga zwi bvaho kha zwifanyiso zwa sathelaithi.
